race.comment: MR REIBY (7) filled a placing on debut at Moruya two back then stepped put over this course and distance last and was just fair in finishing fifth. Has promise and the tongue tie going on today might bring about the required improvement. GRAND CAROUSEL (11) missed the kick then rallied late to get up for third in an impressive performance over 1300m here last time out. Coming along nicely and an extra 100m helps the cause. COPARTNER PEGASUS (2) led but couldn't finish the race off recently over the mile at this track. Should enjoy a nice run up front and is a chance dropping back a little in trip. CORAL COVE (3) came from last in a small field to get up for third at his second race start over 1300m on the Illawarra circuit last time. Plenty of scope for further improvement. FLYING ARABESQUE (5) can do better after a modest first-up effort over 1500m at this track.
